changes.title: House positions
items: In the treehouse, the camera keeps her in view at every station and in every room
Invitations thrown in the treehouse leave her hand, not a spot far below her

changes.title: Faster walk
items: Walking about the treehouse on foot is half again as fast; flying on your broom is unchanged

changes.title: Boot freeze
items: The game no longer freezes for up to a minute ("Page Unresponsive") while it loads: the treehouse's floor is painted in the background
